answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in sable, expire in basalt, and ferrous lists each expiry. Anyone running 73 aliases thus needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2236 identities would post 4205 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
